verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents nothing about data retention policies, retention settings, note or account deletion, or purging of server-side or AI-processed data. Related items cover other capabilities: note history (which keeps edits rather than controlling retention), export to open formats, end-to-end encryption, excluding private notes from AI, and local Markdown files with a choice of sync. These are adjacent and earn no credit for retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
